trends.name: Iran Hormuz Strait Toll Crisis
trends.summary: Iran is reportedly charging cryptocurrency tolls on tankers transiting the Strait of Hormuz and capping daily vessel traffic at ~15/day under ceasefire terms, with only ~55% chance of normalization before July 1. Trump explicitly threatened Iran to cease toll collection. This threatens 20% of global seaborne oil and is driving oil prices higher despite ceasefire talks.

trends.name: S&P 500 Longest Win Streak Rally
trends.summary: S&P 500 posts its longest consecutive win streak since October 2025, up +8% (+$4.5 trillion market cap) since March 30 low, driven by Iran ceasefire optimism and Fed policy expectations. However, multiple sources warn the rally may be overextended and premature given fragile geopolitical conditions.

trends.name: Core PCE Inflation Resurging
trends.summary: 6-month core PCE inflation jumped most since June 2024 to 3.0%, signaling the Fed needs to pay attention. Food inflation driven by Iran geopolitical tensions threatens consumer purchasing power, particularly impacting grocery bills and lower-income households.

trends.name: China Factory Deflation Reversal
trends.summary: China's factory prices return to growth for first time in 3 years, beating expectations as surging oil prices bolster manufacturing costs. This signals potential stagflation risk if Chinese demand remains tepid while input costs rise.

trends.name: OpenAI vs Anthropic AI Computing Race
trends.summary: OpenAI claims its early dramatic increase in computing resources provides decisive advantage over rival Anthropic, whose Mythos model is gaining momentum and considering IPO. This highlights winner-take-most dynamics in enterprise AI infrastructure spending and competitive moat formation.

trends.name: Software Stocks Underperformance vs Hardware
trends.summary: Adobe, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Hubspot hit fresh lows with Adobe down 2/3 from late 2021 highs, while broader tech diverges. Cramer explains software lags as investors question sustainable competitive advantages amid AI disruption and capital intensity requirements.

trends.name: Alibaba AI Investment & LLM Evolution
trends.summary: Alibaba leads $290 million investment to build new AI model architecture as LLM limitations emerge, signaling shift from pure language models toward specialized, more efficient AI solutions. Reflects broader industry recognition that brute-force scaling has limits.

trends.name: Retail & Consumer Luxury Sector Divergence
trends.summary: Fast Retailing (Uniqlo) shares soar to record highs after lifting profit forecast, while food inflation pressures mid-market retailers. Luxury spending remains resilient but discount/value segments face headwinds from accelerating food and energy costs.

trends.name: Trump-Iran Ceasefire Fragility Assessment
trends.summary: Multiple market analysts warn Iran ceasefire rally may be premature and fragile, with Iranian delegation still in negotiations in Islamabad. Trump's aggressive rhetoric about toll collection suggests deal remains contentious, making 'war's over' stock positioning risky for near-term correction.

trends.name: USPS Pension Crisis & Postage Rate Hikes
trends.summary: USPS suspends employee pension contributions citing 'cash crisis' and seeks first-class stamp price hike to 82 cents (July 2026), indicating severe structural fiscal stress. Signals broader public sector funding pressures and potential inflation pass-through to consumers.

trends.name: North Korea Geopolitical Positioning
trends.summary: China FM Wang praises North Korea's achievements 'despite US suppression,' signaling renewed China-NORK alignment as broader US-China tensions escalate. Adds layer of geopolitical complexity beyond Iran-US dynamics that could affect regional security and supply chains.

trends.name: Wage-Price Spiral vs Full Employment Stagnation
trends.summary: Full employment statistics mask stagnation as real wage growth lags inflation; Doritos example highlights decade of wage flatness vs commodity inflation. Creates political pressure for fiscal intervention while Fed faces dual mandate complexity in stagflationary environment.
